About Parul

I am a Mindset
& Manifestation
Coach.

I am an ICF Certified coach. I’m Parul Gupta. I’ve changed careers three times, and not one of those moves started with a full plan, a guarantee, or a clear idea of what was next. Engineer. Designer. Behavioural scientist. Coach.

I help people align their work with who they are becoming, and use mindset and manifestation practices to move from a clear inner vision to meaningful action in the real world.

Each time, I grew faster than made sense on paper. When I walked away from something, more was already waiting for me on the other side. I knew, even then, that I was the asset. Not the title, not the company, me.

None of those leaps started with certainty. Every single one started with one honest conversation with myself, about what wasn’t working anymore and what I was too afraid to actually want.

The asset is you.
